a.admdiv.title: Administrative divisions
a.admdiv.intro: Upload polygon boundary layers — one per administrative level (e.g. Country, Provinces, Municipalities; levels and names differ per country). Accepted formats: GeoJSON (.geojson/.json), zipped Shapefile (.zip), GeoPackage (.gpkg) or KML (.kml/.kmz). Files in another coordinate system are reprojected to WGS 84 automatically when they declare their EPSG code. Layers appear in the map's layer list under “Base layers”.

a.val.r.upperDepth: must be a whole number in [0, 1000]; layers within the same profile must be contiguous (each upper = previous lower)
a.val.r.lowerDepth: must be a whole number ≥ 0 (and greater than upper depth); layers within the same profile must be contiguous
a.val.r.horizon: free-text horizon designation (e.g. A, Bw, C); no format check
a.val.r.resultNum: must be a number; converted to canonical unit
